summary: Frontend-only test of the new Command Center operator wiring at /command-center (Run bounty, Live Job Panel + 2s polling, Stop flow, Execution Settings modal). All run/state/stop endpoints were mocked via Playwright page.route per user's safety rule; no real bounty execution or GitHub PR was triggered. Owner session cookie reused from Mongo user_sessions.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: investigate a transient 403 observed once on a follow-up API call during phase-2 policy reopen (curl-verified PUT/GET /execution/policy return 200 with the owner cookie). If reproducible under load, add retry/backoff or explicit CSRF/origin diagnostics.
critical_code_review_comments: CommandCenter.js polling effect correctly stops when s.active===false and clears timer on unmount (no stale-closure leaks observed).

Stop flow correctly resets `stopping=false` inside the state effect terminal branch and inside doStop's catch, matching the requirement that a failed stop (409) must NOT fabricate STOPPED and must re-enable the Stop button — verified in browser.
canRun(status) is limited to QUALIFIED and AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION as required.

Run button uses busy='run-bounty' shared across rows (setBusy('run-bounty') during run), so if multiple Run buttons existed simultaneously they would all show busy. Minor UX issue — consider per-row busy id (busy===`run-bounty-${id}`). Not blocking because the Run confirmation modal forces one-at-a-time.
Policy save handler correctly leaves modal open on failure (attempt() swallows exception before done? is invoked).
test_credentials: Owner session cookie reused from Mongo user_sessions for user_12742a4c8152 (token expires 2026-09-25). Not persisted to disk.
seed_data_creation: None. Execution policy was temporarily changed to max_total_model_attempts=5 during phase 2, then restored to defaults {4,2,1,2,1} via curl PUT with 200 response — verified via GET.

phase2_execution_settings_modal.verdict: PASS (with a minor test-only re-open flake; PUT/GET both curl-verified 200)

phase4_live_job_polling_terminal_mocked.boundary_text_at_terminal: Terminal state — polling stopped. Draft PR only; no merge is ever performed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Playwright tests used route interception for /api/bounty/execution/bounty/run, /state, /stop. Never click cc-run-confirm without mocks. Owner cookie is `session_token` (SameSite=None, secure). AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION opportunity example: bopp_9e38ae3ac716. Policy currently restored to {4,2,1,2,1}.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The single transient 403 observed once during phase-2 modal reopen did not reproduce via curl and did not affect persistence; likely unrelated background call and not from PUT/GET /execution/policy.
